name: White-eyed Gull
rangeDescription: Red sea and gulf of aqaba to gulf of aden
description: A unique medium-sized, lightly-built gull, confined to the Red Sea. Upperparts dark brown or gray.

name: White-winged Scoter
rangeDescription: Breeds subarctic western alaska to eastern shore of james bay (east-central canada); winters aleutian islands to central california (eastern north pacific coast); and gulf of st. lawrence to new jersey
description: Large scoter, with distinctive white patch on wing. Dark chocolate-brown overall; males are darker than females and have small white mark under eye, dark knob on the bill, and pink bill tip.

name: Chestnut-cheeked Starling
rangeDescription: Southern sakhalin, kuril islands, and northern japan; winters to philippines, sulawesi, and borneo
description: Adult male glossy purple above, white below, with chestnut cheek patch, green wings, and white wing patch most noticeable in flight. Female gray-brown above, white below, and lacks the cheek patch; similar to a female Daurian Starling but less colorful, wing less marked.

name: White-fronted Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar, southern thailand, and malay peninsula
description: Large for a scops-owl. This predominantly light brown species is most readily identified by its bright silvery-gray brow.

name: Xinjiang Ground-Jay
rangeDescription: Desert of northwestern china (western xinjiang)
description: Odd-looking corvid which brings to mind a ground-dwelling desert nutcracker. Pale brownish overall, with black-and-white wing and a thick black mustache which broadens and curves up towards the face.

name: Galapagos Penguin
rangeDescription: Galapagos (fernandina and isabela)
description: The only penguin in Galápagos. Small with a white belly.

name: Inca Wren
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru (cusco)
description: Boldly patterned wren with a localized range in southern Peru. Reddish brown, with a black-and-white streaked face and breast and a bold white eyebrow.

name: Satin Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern queensland to southeastern south australia including tasmania; winters to new guinea
description: A long-tailed, slender songbird with fine bill. Males dark bluish black above, white below, with a dark bib with concave lower edge (curves downward at edges).

name: White-winged Guan
rangeDescription: Dry forest of northwestern peru (tumbes, piura and lambayeque)
description: Large, turkey-like bird restricted to dry forests of northwestern Peru. Dark brown overall, with a red wattle, a pink face patch, and white scaling on the breast.

name: Guadalupe Junco
rangeDescription: Oak-pine forest of guadalupe island (off western baja california)
description: Small, sparrow-like bird found only on Mexico’s Guadalupe Island, located in the Pacific Ocean 160 miles west of Baja California. It has a gray hood, dark face, tawny flanks, pale bill, and white outer tail feathers that flash conspicuously in flight.

name: Puerto Rican Tanager
rangeDescription: Highlands of puerto rico
description: A noisy, gregarious species of middle to high elevation forests where it often forms mixed-species flocks. Typically roosts communally in palm or bamboo thickets.

name: New Caledonian Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of new caledonia and île des pins
description: Enormous, long-tailed, mostly dark slaty-blue pigeon with dark rufous belly and vent. Tail dark chestnut at the base and dark gray towards the tip.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Aberdare Cisticola
rangeDescription: West-central kenya (aberdare mountains)
description: A large and relatively colorful cisticola endemic to Kenya, found locally in montane grassland and moorland. The cap and back of the neck are dull rufous with darker streaking, the back is heavily streaked with black, and there is a rufous panel in the wings.

name: White-winged Lark
rangeDescription: Arid steppes of central eurasia
description: Handsome lark with flashing white wing patches. Note streaky gray-brown back, white underparts, and warm rufous shoulder; male also has distinct red cap and ear coverts.

name: Pied Stilt
rangeDescription: Indonesia to australia and new zealand; winters to philippines
description: Large black-and-white shorebird with long straight, needle-like bill, and very long pink legs. Note black hind-neck.

name: Mallee Emuwren
rangeDescription: Mallee of southeastern australia and adjacent northwestern victoria
description: Tiny buff-brown bird with enormously long, fine tail, found in areas of mallee woodland with large spinifex clumps in a small area of far western Victoria and adjacent South Australia. Crown a clean, rich brown, with streaked back, wings, and cheek; underparts buffy brown.

name: White-backed Swallow
rangeDescription: Southern australia (except southwestern western australia and southern victoria)
description: A very distinctive black-and-white swallow of arid inland Australia. Prominent white upper back, with black belly and black strongly forked tail.

name: Oaxaca Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid highlands of southern mexico (central oaxaca)
description: Very local and endemic to interior of Oaxaca, where replaces larger and bulkier Rusty Sparrow (no known range overlap). Favors brushy woodland and edge and oak thickets with adjacent grassy areas.

name: Santa Marta Woodstar
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Tiny bumblebee-like hummingbird found only in and around Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains, where it is the only woodstar. Usually encountered in cloud forest at moderate elevations, but occasionally wanders down to near sea level.

name: Crimson Chat
rangeDescription: Interior of australia, to southern and western coasts
description: Brightly colored, terrestrial songbird of arid inland Australia. Breeding male has crimson crown and belly, gray back, black mask, white throat, pale eye, and blackish wings with narrow pale wingbars.
